next.reason: 1985: declaratives may appear in any program, nested or not; a declarative is invoked when its USE condition occurs, only a declarative within the separately compiled program containing the statement is invoked, and 'If no qualifying declarative exists ... no declarative is executed'. 2023: USE 'defines the conditions calling for the execution of the use procedures' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR1), executed when the condition occurs (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR6); selection takes 'the qualifying declarative in the source element that contains the statement', then GLOBAL ones in containing source elements up to the outermost (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR4), the order 1985 X.5.5.4 GR1 already gave; 'If no declarative is identified, no declarative is executed' (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR3). Propagation to a caller needs a 2023-only directive. Same effect.
